annotations.title: Check: price, networks and fee wallets

description: The paid Check of any wallet: price { amount (dollars, from one system variable), currency }, tools (scorechain and merkle-science, always both), networks [{ chainId, family, token (the USDC that pays), feeWallet }] (the seven Merkle Science covers: 1, 8453, 10, 42161, 56, 137, solana-mainnet; the same list pays and is analysed) and creditLimit (unused credits one payer may hold). Public, no proof needed.
